items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: So Benny had a show with Victor, the comedian the piano player—

ctx.x: You had to have a vowel at the end of your name to fit with everybody else.

But that changed pretty fast. Benny went through a lot of different players in the fourteen months. And then that band broke up in New York at the 400 Club. Business just went to the — he took the band off the road. Benny had a guarantee of three thousand dollars a night, compared to Harry’s guarantee — this for a dance. And people stopped going to dances. So Benny had a show with Victor, the comedian the piano player—
